eld.notes: Endorsement 660 (ESOL) under Chapter 115 Part II §1.8. Pathway 1 = approved Maine ESOL preparation program; Pathway 3 = 24 SH coursework + one academic semester (≥15 weeks) student teaching; Pathway 5 = approved portfolio. The 5/14/2025 amendment dropped the conditional-cert and Pathway 2 floors from 24 to 15 SH. requirements.test is null because Chapter 115 Part II does not name a Praxis content test for 660; third-party sites cite Praxis 5362 but the binding rule does not.

sei.notes: Sheltered instruction is one optional service component per the 10/9/2025 administrative letter and multilingual-services staffing guidance, not a statewide mandate.

history.title: Maine adopts Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: Maine joined the Seal of Biliteracy program in October 2018, recognizing high school graduates who demonstrate proficiency in English and one or more world languages. Administered through the Maine DOE.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of Maine's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Chapter 115 Part II amended; ESOL coursework floor reduced 24 → 15 SH
history.description: The 5/14/2025 amendment to Chapter 115 Part II §1.8 reduced the conditional-certificate floor and Pathway 2 floor for the 660 (ESOL) endorsement from 24 to 15 semester hours. Pathway 3 retains its 24 SH and one-semester student-teaching requirement. The amendment did not introduce a state-named Praxis content test for the endorsement.

history.title: DOE administrative letter on multilingual-services staffing
history.description: Maine DOE issued an administrative letter and accompanying staffing guidance clarifying that sheltered instruction is one optional component of a district's multilingual-learner service model rather than a statewide mandate for all teachers. Confirms the schema's `sei.mandatedForAllTeachers: false` coding.
